title: Tab Order Visualizer
description:
A browser tool that visualizes the keyboard tab order of any web page and flags focus-related accessibility problems: focus order jumps (WCAG 2.4.3), focusable elements that are not visible (WCAG 2.4.7), clickable elements that cannot be reached with the keyboard (WCAG 2.1.1) and missing focus indicators (WCAG 2.4.7).

It computes sequential focus navigation order following the HTML specification, including shadow DOM, slots, radio groups and positive tabindex, and exports findings as HTML, CSV or Markdown reports. Available as a bookmarklet and a Chrome extension. It collects no user data.
